risks.title: Economic and discretionary consumer spending risk
risks.score_rationale: Under Armour products depend heavily on discretionary purchases that can be negatively affected by economic slowdowns, inflation, unemployment and consumer confidence uncertainty. The 10-K explicitly states: 'our sales, profitability and financial condition could be materially impacted'. Recessions and periods of economic instability reduce discretionary spending.

risks.title: Increased competition and pricing pressure
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive apparel and sports equipment market, with larger companies possessing greater resources, which can impact market share and sales volumes.

risks.title: Supply chain and raw materials risk
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K explicitly identifies: 'Fluctuations in the cost of raw materials and commodities we use in our products and costs related to our supply chain could negatively affect our operating results'. These risks include delivery delays, raw material cost fluctuations and transportation costs.

risks.title: Global business environment and trade policy changes
risks.score_rationale: The MD&A states: 'We expect these changes will have a material impact on our results of operations, including gross profit, in Fiscal 2026'. Potential changes in global trade policy could materially affect operating results and gross margin.

risks.title: Macroeconomic risk: inflation and foreign exchange
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K identifies: 'Other macroeconomic factors, such as inflationary pressures and fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates, have and may continue to impact our business'. These factors affect product input costs, transportation costs and consumer demand.

risks.title: Risk of consumer preference shifts
risks.score_rationale: Changes in consumer preferences regarding fashion, materials, sustainability and performance can impact sales and product relevance.

risks.title: Strategic execution and operational transformation risk
risks.score_rationale: Under Armour is implementing an ambitious restructuring plan of $140-160 million through FY2026. Failure to execute the strategic transformation plan and key initiatives in North America could affect long-term growth and profitability.

ai_positioning.summary: The company has no significant mentions regarding artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided 10-K FY2025 excerpts.
